pose: Macro vertical profile. This transitional pterosaur is perched upright on a vertical Ginkgo tree trunk. Its long, stiff tail extends downward to the bottom margin, while its head with a small crest reaches the top.

environmental_details.ground: Volcanic ash-rich soil and dark grey shale.
environmental_details.flora: Close-up textures of Ginkgo biloba leaves and Cycads.
